audit.why: Even poke-mage lane; both sides run wave-clear burst and the packet's 50.67% WR / level chart (Brand 1-3, Skill 4-6) matches the current phases[].side data already.
Brand's W-Q combo comes online at 2 before Hwei has picked a second spell slot; Hwei catches up once he has E (fear/root CC) and R at 6; first item both scale evenly as DoT/burst mages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every occurrence of the enemy ability is written as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)', which is not a real Hwei ability name. His E slot is 'Subject: Torment', whose Grim Visage sub-spell applies Fear — the correct AbilityName(Effect) form is 'Subject: Torment (Fear)'. Also missing: his W slot ('Subject: Serenity') carries a shield sub-spell that absorbs burst and changes all-in math — flagged in missingInteractions but not written anywhere in the page.
audit.why: enemyKit.abilities E slot = 'Subject: Torment' (flags.hardCC, flags.slow); W slot = 'Subject: Serenity' (flags.shield: absorbs burst — changes all-in maths). missingInteractions[0] explicitly calls out the W shield.
audit.corrected: Renamed the fabricated ability to 'Subject: Torment (Fear)' everywhere it appears, and added the W-shield interaction into breakdown.trading so players bait it before committing.

edits.before: Good trade: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after. Bad trade: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
